summary:
Full-stack test of Fifthback's NEW Distinction Questioner + Evaluator AI workers (Claude Sonnet 4.6 via Emergent). Backend: 4/4 new pytest passed (test_distinction_evaluate.py) plus 3 regression checks from backend_test.py still green. POST /api/distinction with 'İstifa edesim var.' returned should_ask=true with a Turkish question ('İstifa düşünceni en çok ne besliyor?') and 5 Turkish options (no 'Hiçbiri' in options). POST /api/distinction with 'Destek ekibi harikaydı, gerçekten minnettarım.' returned should_ask=false with a Turkish stop_reason and empty options. POST /api/distinction with '   ' returned 400. POST /api/evaluate returned a refined interpretation with all journey fields (signals verbatim substrings of combined text+answer, active_needs>=1, org+personal responsibility, >=2 channels, prevalence object), supported bool, and Turkish evaluation_note. Frontend: typing 'İstifa edesim var.' + submit rendered solution-journey; step-distinction was inserted after interpret (journey-step-dot-5 exists → 6 steps). step-distinction contains distinction-question, 5 distinction-option-{i}, distinction-none, distinction-freetext, submit-distinction-btn, skip-distinction-btn. Selecting options 0+1 and clicking submit-distinction-btn called /api/evaluate, rendered evaluator-result inline with the grounding note ('Sinyallerin üçü de çalışanın metnine doğrudan dayanmaktadır…'), and the journey STAYED at 6 dots (interpretation.id preserved → no remount/reset). Navigation to remaining steps (prevalence/tension/responsibility/closure) works and final confirm-interpretation-btn / correct-interpretation-btn / add-more-btn are visible. Skills loaded: ai-testing-core, ai-testing-llm. LiteLLM logs confirm real claude-sonnet-4-6 calls for /interpret, /distinction, and /evaluate at test times.

Feature verdicts:
- POST /api/distinction (ambiguous → ask) - pass - evidence: should_ask=true, question='İstifa düşünceni en çok ne besliyor?', 5 TR options, no 'hiçbiri'; skill: ai-testing-llm.
- POST /api/distinction (clear → stop) - pass - evidence: should_ask=false + non-empty Turkish stop_reason, options=[]; skill: ai-testing-llm.
- POST /api/distinction (empty) - pass - evidence: 400 with detail; skill: ai-testing-llm.
- POST /api/evaluate (refined + grounding) - pass - evidence: verbatim substring checks on refined signals evidence against combined text+answer, org/personal responsibility non-empty, ≥2 channels, supported=bool, note non-empty TR; skill: ai-testing-llm.
- Frontend distinction step insertion + submit flow - pass - evidence: 6 journey dots after interpret, evaluator-result rendered after submit, 6 dots retained (no reset).
critical_code_review_comments: SolutionJourney.js has grown to ~638 lines with the added Distinction step body inline. It is still under the 700-line soft limit but should be split (StepDistinction, StepUnderstand, ...) before the next feature; the 5-step review already flagged this and the new step made it worse.

server.py now has 3 LLM workers (interpret, distinction, evaluator) sharing near-identical LlmChat scaffolding. Extract a single _call_claude_json(system, prompt) helper to remove duplication and centralize the JSON-parsing/error path.

distinction_with_llm silently swallows exceptions and returns should_ask=false with a generic stop_reason ('Ek soru üretilemedi.'). Same for evaluate_grounding which defaults to supported=True. This masks real LLM failures from monitoring — add a WARN log with the exception and consider bubbling a metric.

In /api/evaluate the interp_with_llm is re-run on the combined text with 3 sequential Claude calls total (interpret + evaluate + prevalence read). Endpoint p95 is 25–40s per the task brief; consider running interpret and evaluator against the same combined text in a single prompt or in parallel to cut latency. Real users on the preview URL will hit the Cloudflare 100s ceiling if network is slow.

SolutionJourney useEffect for askDistinction has an empty dep array and disables react-hooks/exhaustive-deps. This is intentional (askedRef gate) but is fragile: if `interpretation` changes prop identity (e.g. after evaluate), a future refactor could re-fire the call. Prefer keying on interpretation.id in the ref check.

Distinction options are rendered with array-index keys and no de-duplication; if the LLM ever returns two identical options they will still both render and be selectable — add a lower-case dedupe in normalization on the backend.
No rate limiting on the new /api/distinction and /api/evaluate — each user turn now costs up to 3 LLM calls. Add per-IP/session throttling before the demo is exposed publicly.

EvaluateRequest.answer is Field-less string; empty answer bypasses the composed-combined branch and just re-interprets the original text. Add server-side validation to reject empty answer with 400 (or make it optional & documented).
test_credentials: not applicable - app has no auth
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Existing 5 seeded Turkish patterns + prior live TEST_ patterns from iteration_2 are still in Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoints /api/distinction and /api/evaluate both work with real Claude Sonnet 4.6 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. Distinction correctly asks for multi-signal ambiguous text and stops for clearly single-signal positive text (no Hiçbiri in options — UI adds it). Evaluate returns full refined journey + grounding. Frontend inserts the distinction step ONLY when should_ask=true → journey has 6 dots (journey-step-dot-0..5); when should_ask=false the journey stays at 5 dots (verified by backend contract + frontend memo). Data-testids verified: distinction-question, distinction-option-{0..4}, distinction-none, distinction-freetext, submit-distinction-btn, skip-distinction-btn, evaluator-result. Interpretation id preservation on setInterpretation keeps journey from remounting on evaluate. Tests: /app/backend/tests/test_distinction_evaluate.py — export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and run with pytest.
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional bugs found this iteration.
